S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 future settled 1089.6, down 7.1 points (-0.65%) on 22 Jul, with 26 strikes live from 910 to 1150. Put OI outweighs calls 1.90:1 (24,653 vs 12,955), and max pain has held at 1060 for five straight sessions even as spot round-tripped from 1073 to 1096.6 and back. Cumulative dealer gamma turns positive only above strike 1110, so at today's 1089.6 the desk is net short gamma, with the deepest short-gamma concentration at 1050 (net GEX approx -529). The 25-delta skew flipped to -0.71 (call-rich) today from +1.02 yesterday, suggesting the put-hedging bid faded into the drop rather than intensifying.
what_changed: Future fell 7.1 points to 1089.6, reversing three sessions of gains (1073 to 1096.6 from Jul 15-21).
25-delta skew flipped from +1.02 (put-rich) yesterday to -0.71 (call-rich) today, the first negative reading in the 5-day window.
Near put wall at 1050 jumped 14% to 1,326 contracts (from 1,164), the single largest one-day OI build of the week.
Near call wall held at 1100 (1,491 OI, +6% vs 1,409 yesterday) while the deep 1080 structural wall stayed flat (1,925 to 1,915).
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has been glued to 1060 across all five sessions from Jul 15 (spot 1073) through today (spot 1089.6), confirming it as a stable anchor rather than a moving target. Total put OI grew 41% over the week (17,505 to 24,653) versus call OI's 13% growth (11,481 to 12,955), pushing the P/C OI ratio from 1.52 to 1.90 and building a genuine near-money floor at 1050 (OI 1,069 to 1,326). The near call wall at 1100 grew in parallel (1,339 to 1,491), so the week's flow has reinforced a 1050-1100 box rather than resolved it. The one crack: today's skew flip from put-rich (+1.02 to +2.54 all week) to call-rich (-0.71) alongside the -7.1 point drop suggests this decline was not accompanied by fresh downside-hedging demand, arguing against a fear-driven move. ATM IV stayed range-bound 12.98%-13.77% all week with no expansion, so the options market is not yet pricing a breakout of the 1050-1100 box.

strategies.name: Long strangle 1050 put / 1130 call
strategies.rationale: Dealer short gamma across the 1050-1100 box plus flat 13.3% IV means a breakout in either direction gets amplified rather than faded, so long premium captures that move cheaply while direction stays undecided.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = total premium paid: 1050P ask 12.0 + 1130C ask 9.8 = 21.8 points (4,360 baht per pair at the 200 baht/point multiplier).
strategies.invalidation: Spot pins inside the 1050-1100 box into expiry without IV expansion; theta decay steadily erodes the position over a 69-day hold.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1090P / 1050P
strategies.rationale: Today's -7.1 point drop plus dealer short gamma below the 1110 flip means further downside toward the 1060 max pain and 1050 wall gets amplified, not faded.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid: 1090P ask 26.2 minus 1050P bid 11.6 = 14.6 points (2,920 baht at the 200 baht/point multiplier).
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1100 near call wall reasserts the upper half of the range and negates the bearish continuation thesis.

S50U26.prediction: Bias: mildly bearish-neutral within the 1050-1100 box - expect chop with a lean toward the 1060 max pain given today's -7.1 point drop and a fading put-hedging bid (skew -0.71). A close below the 1050 near put wall would confirm the short-gamma squeeze lower toward the deep 910 structural floor; a close back above 1100 reopens the path to the 1080 deep call wall and negates the bearish lean. Watch the 9.15-point 1-sigma range around 1089.6 (roughly 1080.5-1098.8) for the next session's directional tell.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not a trade recommendation. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the pinning/max-pain mechanics here are structurally weaker than for share-settled single-stock options; treat every wall and pin level as a tendency, not a guarantee, especially given today's skew flip and the 69-day-out expiry.
